race.comment: DU CLISSON (5) showed good early dash when resuming last start and held on well to finish 1.3 lengths back in second over 1000m at Warrnambool. Second-up winner who'll be better for it, has drawn well and gets in nicely after the claim. MR ASSERTIVE (1) finished eighth over 1100m at this track last time out, which was a handy race on Cup Day, following a determined win two runs back. Draws to get his chance here. SEA POEM (3) hasn't been far away recently including last time out when second over 1100m at Bendigo. Goes well at this journey with two wins and two placings from six starts and cannot be underestimated. HEY JESSIE (8) has been off the scene for a while but was tested in Group class this time last year and, while outclassed there, she looks up to this grade and heads into this off a nice recent trial win over Peyton, who won at Flemington during Cup Week. REDDERS (2) is another first-upper who's been trialling well.
